mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 0.25% per annum over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.0% for two consecutive months indicates weak labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mean return is not significantly below zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST below their previous 12-month moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which depresses earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 12M MA and HOUST < 12M MA simultaneously
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly negative at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent fall in INDPRO below 98 for three consecutive months signals supply chain stress, which raises input costs and reduces profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mean return is not significantly below zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in CPIAUCSL below 2.0% while FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% for four consecutive months signals a deflationary environment with accommodative policy, which boosts risk appetite and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.25% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly positive at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in PAYEMS above its previous 12-month moving average for two consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the mean return is not significantly above zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 and RSAFS above their previous 6-month moving averages for one month signals a broad-based demand recovery, which lifts earnings expectations and results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 6M MA and RSAFS > 6M MA for 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly positive at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO rising above 102 for four consecutive months while FEDFUNDS is stable (change < 0.1% per month) signals improving supply conditions in a neutral monetary environment, which supports margin expansion and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 102 for 4 consecutive months and |FEDFUNDS change| < 0.1% per month
regime_hint: neutral monetary policy with supply normalization
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not significantly positive at 5% significance.
